verses.1: Unto the end. For those who will be changed. The testimony of Asaph. A Psalm.
verses.2: The One who reigns over Israel: Be attentive. For you lead Joseph like a sheep. The One who sits upon the cherubim: Shine forth
verses.3: in the presence of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Awaken your power and draw near, so as to accomplish our salvation.
verses.4: Convert us, O God. And reveal your face, and we will be saved.
verses.5: O Lord, God of hosts, how long will you be angry over the prayer of your servant?
verses.6: How long will you feed us the bread of tears, and give us to drink a full measure of tears?
verses.7: You have set us as a contradiction to our neighbors. And our enemies have ridiculed us.
verses.8: O God of hosts, convert us. And reveal your face, and we will be saved.
verses.9: You have transferred a vineyard from Egypt. You have cast out the Gentiles, and planted it.
verses.10: You were the leader of the journey in its sight. You planted its roots, and it filled the earth.
verses.11: Its shadow covered the hills, and its branches covered the cedars of God.
verses.12: It extended its new branches even to the sea, and its new seedlings even to the river.
verses.13: So then, why have you destroyed its walls, so that all those who pass by the way gather its grapes?
verses.14: The wild boar of the forest has trampled it, and a single wild beast has laid waste to it.
verses.15: Turn back, O God of hosts. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vineyard;
verses.16: and complete what your right hand has planted, and look upon the son of man, whom you have confirmed for yourself.
verses.17: Whatever has been set on fire and dug under will perish at the rebuke of your countenance.
verses.18: Let your hand be over the man on your right, and over the son of man, whom you have confirmed for yourself.
verses.19: For we do not depart from you, and you will revive us. And we will invoke your name.
verses.20: O Lord, God of hosts, convert us. And reveal your face, and we will be saved. [ Psalm 80 ] (81)
